# FluxWall

> FluxWall is a procedural live wallpaper app for Android. It renders evolving OpenGL shader worlds in realtime instead of playing a fixed video loop.

## Canonical website

- Website: https://fluxwall.abhishekbansal.dev/
- Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrapps.infinitetunnel
- Public source repository: https://github.com/abhishekBansal/fluxwall

## What FluxWall is

FluxWall is a mobile live wallpaper studio for Android. Users can explore a curated set of shader-based worlds, preview them in realtime, and customize supported visual parameters such as color, speed, glow, density, and flow. The Android app is available on Google Play.

FluxWall is designed for Android devices that support live wallpapers. It does not require an account, and the app contains no ads or tracking.

## Featured public worlds

The public website showcases five curated shader experiences:

- Infinite Tunnel: a 3D tunnel journey with luminous rings and motion.
- Magic Fluids: abstract liquid-like color fields with flowing motion.
- Aurora Field: flowing aurora-like color bands over a dark sky.
- Synthwave Sun: a retro sun and grid-inspired synthwave scene.
- Galaxy: a cosmic starfield and galaxy-inspired scene.

## How it works

FluxWall uses OpenGL shaders to generate wallpaper frames on the device. The motion is generated continuously, so scenes can evolve without repeating a prerecorded video. The public website includes a JavaScript preview for the featured shader experiences.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is FluxWall a video wallpaper?

No. FluxWall renders shader-based scenes in realtime on the device. It is not a fixed video loop.

### What can users customize?

Each shader world can expose its own controls. Available controls may include color palettes, speed, glow, density, flow mode, and related visual parameters.

### Does FluxWall need an account?

No. FluxWall does not require an account. Favorites and presets are stored locally on the device according to the app's user settings.

### Does FluxWall contain ads?

The public website states that the app has no ads, no account, and no tracking inside the app.

### Where can FluxWall be downloaded?

FluxWall is available on Google Play at:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rrapps.infinitetunnel

## Content and crawler policy

The public website is intended to be readable by people, search engines, and user-directed AI agents. The canonical website is the source of truth for product facts and links. Crawlers should respect the site's `robots.txt`, canonical URLs, and `sitemap.xml`.

The website's public shader catalog is intentionally curated. The private application repository contains the complete implementation and additional internal development material.
